questions.question:
A company stores its monthly sales data in Google Sheets. The management team wants an
interactive dashboard in Looker Studio that updates when the Google Sheet is updated. What
should you do first?

options.text: Connect the Google Sheet as a data source

questions.question:
A CEO wants to see four important KPIs at the top of a dashboard:
   Total Revenue
   Total Orders
   Profit
   Conversion Rate
Which Looker Studio visualization is most appropriate?

A sales manager wants to see how revenue changes from January through December. Which
visualization is most appropriate?

A company wants to compare total sales across five product categories. Which visualization
would be most appropriate?

A manager wants to see the percentage contribution of each product category to total revenue.
Which chart is appropriate?

A sales manager wants to see every salesperson with their Sales, Orders, and Profit in rows.
Which visualization is most suitable?

A dashboard contains sales for multiple countries. Users should be able to select a country and
update the charts automatically. Which feature should you use?

A manager wants to select a custom date range and have all relevant charts update
automatically. Which control should be added?

A dataset contains Country, Product, Revenue, and Orders. Which fields are generally
dimensions?
Which of the following is most likely to be used as a metric in a sales dashboard?

A company wants to calculate profit margin using:
Profit / Revenue
Which Looker Studio feature should be used?

You need a calculated field that classifies customers as "High Value" when Revenue is greater
than 10,000 and "Regular" otherwise. Which type of calculation is appropriate?

A marketing dashboard needs to classify campaigns:
   Search → Paid Search
   Display → Display Advertising
   Social → Social Media
Which calculated-field technique is appropriate?

A manager wants to display the total amount of revenue generated. Which aggregation should
generally be used?

A company wants to know the average order value. Which aggregation would be appropriate
if the dataset already contains an Order Value field?

A company wants to know how many orders were recorded. Which aggregation is appropriate
when each row represents an order?

A customer can place multiple orders. Management wants to know the number of unique
customers who made purchases. Which function is most appropriate?

A company has one data source containing website traffic and another containing advertising
cost. The sources share a common Date field. Management wants to compare traffic and
advertising cost in one chart. What Looker Studio feature can help?

When blending two data sources, you need a common field such as Date or Customer ID to
match records. What is this field generally called?

You blend two datasets using Customer ID, but many records do not match. What should you
investigate first?

options.text: Whether the join keys have matching values and compatible formats

questions.question:
A Google Sheet contains customer names with inconsistent capitalization such as:
   John Smith
   JOHN SMITH
   john smith
What should you consider before creating reliable customer-level analysis?

A Revenue field contains blank values. What should an analyst do before calculating
important KPIs?

options.text: Investigate and appropriately handle the missing values

questions.question:
A product table displays products alphabetically, but management wants the products with
the highest revenue at the top. What should you change?

options.text: Sort by Revenue in descending order

questions.question:
Management wants to see only the 10 products generating the most revenue. Which approach
is appropriate?

A sales table should display profitable products in green and products with losses in red.
Which feature is useful?

A company has sales data by country and wants to visualize performance geographically.
Which Looker Studio visualization is appropriate?

A map displays different countries. Management wants countries with higher sales to appear
with stronger colors. What should determine the color intensity?

A company wants one page for executive KPIs, another for marketing performance, and
another for detailed sales analysis. What should be used?

A dashboard contains several pages. Users need an easy way to move between Executive
Overview, Sales, and Marketing pages. Which feature is useful?

A manager wants one dashboard where selecting a country updates several charts on the same
page. What is the main feature that enables this interaction?

A user clicks a bar representing "Electronics" and wants other compatible charts to update
based on that selection. Which functionality can provide this type of interaction?

A marketing manager wants to compare:
   Impressions
   Clicks
   Cost
   Conversions
   Conversion Rate
by advertising campaign. Which visualization would be particularly useful for comparing
campaign performance?

options.text: Table with Campaign as the dimension and the metrics as columns

questions.question:
An executive dashboard contains 20 charts, 12 filters, and many colors. Users find it difficult
to understand. What is the best approach?

options.text: Simplify the dashboard and prioritize the most important KPIs and visualizations
Use a different color for every metric

questions.question:
A company wants all dashboard pages to use the same colors, fonts, and general visual style.
Which feature should be used?

A company has completed a Looker Studio dashboard and wants managers to access it
without editing the report. What should be configured?

A management team wants to receive a regular copy of a dashboard/report by email. Which
functionality is relevant?

A company wants a sales dashboard containing:
   Total Revenue
   Total Orders
   Average Order Value
   Sales by Product
   Sales by Country
   Monthly Sales Trend
   Top 10 Products
   Date filtering
   Country filtering
The data is stored in Google Sheets and is updated regularly. What is the most appropriate
overall approach?

options.text:
Connect the Google Sheet, create appropriate dimensions and metrics, build calculated fields
where required, add charts and scorecards, and use filter/date controls for interaction.
Create only a static image of the spreadsheet.
Create one pie chart containing all fields.
Convert all metrics into dimensions before creating the dashboard.

questions.question:
A company has website traffic data and advertising cost data in separate sources. Both
sources contain a Date field. The marketing manager wants to display Website Sessions and
Advertising Cost together by date. What should you do?

options.text: Blend the data sources using Date as the join key

questions.question:
A sales dashboard has Revenue and Cost fields. Management wants to calculate Profit
automatically for every product. Which calculated field is most appropriate?

A company wants to calculate the conversion rate using:
Conversions / Sessions
Which approach is most appropriate?

options.text: Create a calculated field using the conversion and session metrics

questions.question:
A marketing manager wants to classify campaigns into two groups. Campaigns with more
than 1,000 conversions should be "High Performance" and the rest should be "Standard". Which
approach should be used?

A company has sales from January through December and wants users to select a specific
period, such as March through August, while automatically updating the dashboard charts.
Which feature should be used?

A manager wants a table showing Product, Revenue, Orders, and Profit. The manager wants
the highest-revenue products to appear first. Which combination is most appropriate?

options.text: Table visualization with Revenue used for descending sorting
Pie chart with Product as a metric

questions.question:
A company has sales data for Egypt, Saudi Arabia, UAE, and Jordan. Management wants to
select one country and have the Sales by Product and Monthly Sales charts update automatically.
Which feature should be configured?

A dashboard shows sales by country on a map. Management wants countries with high sales
to have darker colors and countries with low sales to have lighter colors. Which configuration
should be used?

options.text: Use Sales as the map's metric/color value
Use Customer Name as the metric
Use Product ID as the color metric
Use the dashboard title as the color value

questions.question:
A company has five product categories and wants to show each category's percentage of total
sales. Which visualization and analysis would be most appropriate?

options.text: Pie chart showing the percentage contribution of each category

questions.question:
A marketing dashboard contains Search, Display, and Social campaigns. The company wants
to display these as Paid Search, Display Advertising, and Social Media in its analysis. Which
feature is most appropriate?

A dashboard contains revenue values of 10,000, 25,000, 50,000, and 100,000. Management
wants the 100,000 value to stand out clearly as the highest value. Which feature could help in a
table?

A dashboard has separate pages for Sales, Marketing, and Executive KPIs. Users complain
that they cannot easily move from one page to another. What should you add?

A company is building a complete Looker Studio sales and marketing dashboard. The data
comes from Google Sheets, website traffic needs to be analyzed, advertising costs need to be
compared with traffic, and management needs interactive filtering, KPI scorecards, product
analysis, geographic analysis, and monthly trends.
Which approach is the most appropriate?

options.text:
Connect the required data sources, use appropriate dimensions and metrics, blend sources
using suitable join keys where needed, create calculated fields for KPIs, use
scorecards/charts/maps/tables, and add date and filter controls for interaction.
Use only a single pie chart containing all available fields.
Convert all dimensions into metrics and remove the filters.
Create separate static images instead of interactive charts.
